view.scene_description: A wide-angle view of a warehouse interior with high ceilings and concrete floors. Red metal shelving units on the right hold stacked boxes. A blue safety barrier with yellow base rails divides the space. A silver car is parked near a loading dock door in the background. Pallet jacks rest beside shelves. Lighting fixtures are mounted on walls and ceiling.

objects.label: silver car
objects.observation: A silver SUV parked near the center-left, partially behind a blue safety barrier. Its front is facing the camera. The vehicle is stationary and appears to be in a loading bay area. No visible damage or motion blur.

objects.label: blue safety barrier
objects.observation: A tall blue metal frame with mesh panels, positioned centrally. It has a yellow base rail and a yellow sign with black letters 'AA U'. It separates the foreground from the background area where the car is parked.

objects.label: red metal shelving unit
objects.observation: Tall red metal racks on the right side, filled with cardboard boxes and pallets. Each shelf has white labels. Two blue pallet jacks are parked at its base. The shelves extend vertically out of frame.

objects.label: pallet jacks
objects.observation: Two blue manual pallet jacks standing upright on the floor next to the red shelving unit. They have wheels and handles. One is slightly closer to the camera than the other.

objects.label: loading dock door
objects.observation: A large blue roll-up door located in the background, behind the silver car. It is partially open, revealing bright light from outside. The door is framed by structural beams.

objects.label: cardboard boxes
objects.observation: Multiple cardboard boxes stacked on pallets within the red shelving unit. Some are plain brown, others have printed labels. Boxes are arranged neatly on various shelves.

prompts.native_chat_prompt_text:
<|im_start|>system
You are a helpful assistant<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>user
<|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|>Inspect the photograph. Return ONLY one JSON object, no markdown or text outside JSON. Describe the complete scene and list visible objects with separate local integer IDs, separating instances when possible. For every object describe visible appearance, image-relative location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relationships. State uncertainty; do not infer hidden fasteners, weight or permanent installation. Do not classify stability or mobility. Use English text.
Required JSON structure (the angle-bracket text specifies field meaning, not example objects):
{"scene_description":"<full scene description>","objects":[{"id":1,"label":"<visible object name>","observation":"<visible appearance, location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relations>","attachment_evidence":"not_visible","identifiable":true}]}
List all discernible objects, not just one. Every object needs these five fields. attachment_evidence must be visible_installation, appears_freestanding, not_visible or mixed; visible_installation requires visible mounting or integration. Use not_visible when attachment cannot be established. scene_description about 120 words or fewer; each observation about 60 words or fewer.

Describe the photograph using these inputs:
{"frame_id": "loco-s3-36412", "image_size": [1920, 1080], "annotation_kind": "unspecified", "supplied_objects": null}<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>assistant
